guard/31987.htm.text: Guard Gotter: I'm new here and don't know much about this territory... I'm more familiar with the Plunderous Plains. They're not far from here... Would you like to hear about them?

links.text: "Who is the lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"

guard/31987-1.htm.text: Guard Gotter: The Plunderous Plains are as dreary as they sound! An old railroad crosses them, and goes all the way to Schuttgart Castle. There's a Strip Mine in the east that was abandoned by the Dwarves, and an old harbor in the south. When traveling there you must beware of the gangs of bandits …
